==Biography==
Daniel del Castillo, also known as 'El Capi' as the captain of the squad, is not only the leader in the Summoner's Rift, he is also a reference in the top lane. With a style of play that can vary between hauling and sacrifice, Jirall is one of the players that dominates the decision making, highlighted by his teleports during ambushes and counter-ambushes. He is also listed as an impossible player to ambush by dominating the game early when he is at a disadvantage and has to play under the rook.

== Trivia ==
* His name comes from the same character who appears in the game The Last Story.
* His older brother, Rodrigo "'''[[Yeti (Rodrigo del Castillo)|Yeti]]'''" del Castillo, was his coach on several different teams. 
* He also likes to play ''Super Smash Bros. Melee''.
